entries.label: church-turing-adequacy
entries.definition: any physically realizable process is computable — simulable to arbitrary accuracy by a Turing machine
sourceForms: any physically realizable process **is computable** — simulable to arbitrary accuracy by a Turing machine

entries.label: classical-sufficiency-position
entries.definition: neural computation is adequately described classically, quantum effects are thermal noise, and consciousness supervenes on classically-describable neural dynamics

entries.label: coevolution-position
entries.definition: the code expanded alongside amino acid biosynthetic pathways, pattern reflects metabolic history rather than optimization

entries.label: computable
entries.definition: simulable to arbitrary accuracy by a Turing machine

entries.label: consciousness-quantum-constitution
entries.definition: the axis classifying positions on whether consciousness is quantum-mechanically constituted

entries.label: decoherence-objection
entries.definition: decoherence times for microtubule-scale superpositions in a warm, wet, ionic brain are too short for any neurally relevant process

entries.label: enabling-bridge
entries.definition: the code was optimized for error-robustness, which permits open-ended complexity, and consciousness is a downstream consequence
sourceForms: The weak synthesis asserts only that the code was optimized for error-robustness, that error-robustness permits open-ended complexity, and that consciousness is a downstream consequence of that complexity

entries.label: error-minimization-position
entries.definition: the standard genetic code is extraordinarily good at minimizing phenotypic impact of point mutations and mistranslations, evidence of selection for robustness

entries.label: established-effects-position
entries.definition: non-trivial quantum effects are demonstrated in biology: radical-pair magnetoreception and enzymatic hydrogen tunnelling

entries.label: frozen-accident-position
entries.definition: assignments were largely arbitrary and became fixed because any change would be catastrophically disruptive

entries.label: genetic-code-optimization
entries.definition: the axis classifying positions on what the genetic code was optimized for
sourceForms: what was the genetic code optimized for

entries.label: not-computable
entries.definition: not simulable to arbitrary accuracy by a Turing machine

entries.label: orch-or-position
entries.definition: consciousness arises from orchestrated objective reduction of quantum states in microtubules, requires sustained quantum coherence, and is not computable by a Turing machine

entries.label: photosynthesis-retraction-position
entries.definition: long-lived electronic coherence in photosynthetic complexes is now attributed to vibrational rather than electronic coherence, and functional role is contested

entries.label: quantum-biology-reality
entries.definition: the axis classifying positions on whether quantum biology is real

entries.label: selection-for
entries.definition: a trait is selected for only if it is causally responsible for differential reproductive success at the time of selection
sourceForms: a trait is selected *for* only if it is causally responsible for differential reproductive success at the time of selection

entries.label: stereochemical-position
entries.definition: codon–amino-acid assignments reflect direct physicochemical affinity between triplets and residues

entries.label: substrate-bridge
entries.definition: consciousness depends on the specific quantum-mechanical substrate that biological molecules instantiate
sourceForms: consciousness depends on the specific quantum-mechanical substrate that biological molecules instantiate

entries.label: substrate-independence
entries.definition: a mental kind can be realized in physically heterogeneous substrates
sourceForms: a mental kind can be realized in physically heterogeneous substrates

entries.label: teleological-bridge
entries.definition: the genetic code was optimized for consciousness
sourceForms: The strong synthesis asserts that the genetic code was optimized *for* consciousness

entries.label: corpus-narrator
entries.definition: the corpus speaking in its own voice — the author's observations, framing and analytical apparatus, as distinct from any position the corpus reports
